summary: End-to-end tested new 'Anggaran Bulanan' feature (backend budget endpoints + realisasi computation + RBAC + /anggaran UI). All 10 pytest cases pass; UI create/edit/delete flow via BudgetModal works correctly with data-testid selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_budgets: realisasi correctly filters status in [approved, posted] and month prefix from tanggal||created_at — matches acceptance criteria.
POST /api/budgets upserts on (unit_kerja, period); reuses existing id and updates amount/catatan. Correct.
RBAC via require_roles('admin','keuangan') enforced on POST/PUT/DELETE; GET open to all authed users. Verified with temp approver+user accounts (403).
no_budget row synthesized when a unit has realisasi but no budget doc — sisa = -realisasi, amount = 0, id = None. Correct.
Minor: budget row with id=None cannot be deleted from UI (Delete button hidden for no_budget rows — intended). OK.
Minor design: 4th stat card 'Unit Melebihi Pagu' shows integer 0 without 'unit' suffix — fine but could read '0 unit'.
PUT /api/budgets/{bid} does not check if bid exists (silently returns null when not found). Consider 404 on missing id.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all acceptance checks: page load, stat cards, add/edit/delete via modal, progress bar)
